title: The text discusses the global food crisis that emerged in 2008, highlighting food riots in various countries, including India, Pakistan, and the Philippines. It notes the deployment of the Pakistani Army to prevent food seizures and the rising food prices despite government efforts. The article questions the simultaneous occurrence of food crises worldwide and explores various causes, including weather conditions, increased demand, energy prices, and agricultural policies. It mentions differing opinions from world leaders on the causes of the crisis, with significant price increases in staple foods like rice, wheat, and maize since 2006.
